Position Available: Kitchenhand
Location: Darwin. Northern Territory
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $67,510–$75,000

ABOUT US
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER
We are supporting a hospitality group (SXW Pty Ltd) based in Darwin that operates across several popular venues, specialising in Aussie-Italian and Aussie-Filipino fusion cuisine. The business is known for it's commitment to handcrafted meals, warm service, and consistent customer satisfaction. They are currently hiring for the following role: Kitchenhand. These roles offer a great opportunity to join a dynamic team and grow within a stable, fast-paced hospitality environment.

KITCHEN HAND
Job Overview:
The Kitchen Hand supports the kitchen team by maintaining hygiene standards, assisting with food prep, and ensuring clean and safe kitchen operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Wash dishes, kitchen equipment, and surfaces
Assist in basic food preparation.
Manage garbage disposal and restocking.
Comply with food safety and hygiene regulations.

Requirements:
Experience in a kitchen environment preferred.
Reliability, physical stamina, and attention to detail.
Ability to follow instructions and maintain standards.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
Competitive salary starting at $67,510 (with scope to increase based on experience)
Opportunities for internal advancement and skills training
Positive, inclusive work environment

Non-monetary benefits may include staff meals 
*Salary ranges for eligible roles may reach up to $75,000 depending on skills, responsibilities and experience.

HOW TO APPLY
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about hospitality and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.

To apply, submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
Why you are applying for this position; and
An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a vibrant team and contributing to a high-quality hospitality experience, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in applications will not be accepted.

result.description:
GDR 1 Pty Ltd T/A Alegre Bar & Dining is a premium waterfront restaurant and bar located at King Street Wharf, Darling Harbour, Sydney, NSW. Alegre offers a contemporary dining experience inspired by the vibrant flavours and culture of Mexico, thoughtfully combined with premium Australian produce and modern culinary techniques. The restaurant has established itself as a distinctive hospitality destination, renowned for its exceptional cuisine, handcrafted cocktails, extensive beverage selection, and outstanding customer service. Due to the continued growth of the business and increasing competition within Sydney's hospitality industry, GDR 1 Pty Ltd T/A Alegre Bar & Dining is seeking to employ a full-time Marketing Specialist.

About the role:
The Marketing Specialist plays a key role in developing and implementing strategic marketing initiatives that enhance the brand presence of GDR 1 Pty Ltd T/A Alegre Bar & Dining, increase customer engagement, and support the business's growth objectives. Working closely with management, venue operations, event coordinators, and external marketing partners, the Marketing Specialist will plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels to promote the restaurant's dining experiences, events, and hospitality services.

Key Responsibilities: 
•	Develop, implement, and evaluate strategic marketing plans to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, and revenue growth.
•	Conduct market research and analyse consumer behaviour, industry trends, and competitor activities to identify new marketing opportunities.
•	Plan and coordinate integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional platforms, including social media, email marketing, online advertising, and promotional events.
•	Develop and manage engaging marketing content for the company's website, social media platforms, newsletters, and other promotional materials.
•	Monitor and analyse the performance of marketing campaigns using relevant analytics tools and prepare reports with recommendations for continuous improvement.
•	Manage the restaurant's online presence, including social media engagement, customer reviews, and digital reputation management.
•	Assist in developing marketing budgets and ensure promotional activities are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
•	Work closely with the management team to develop innovative marketing strategies that support the business's long-term commercial objectives and continued growth.

Candidate must have:
•	1-2 years previous experience as a Marketing Specialist. 
•	Be able to work within a team to continue to meet the high standards expected excellent communicate.
•	Relevant qualification of industry skills or proven experience
•	Strong management and planning skills
•	Understanding of performance marketing metrics, reporting, and optimisation techniques. 
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
•	Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

We will provide:
•	Good working environment
•	Complete support from management
If you are interested in the role available please apply with a resume and cover letter.

Provide personal care, including showering, dressing, grooming, and toileting assistance.
